title: Tilt-card quickstart canvas for credential flows, streaming, and tool calls
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a compact, stepwise quickstart canvas using a tilt-card visual motif to teach developers three core onboarding flows: API credential setup (key generation and rotation), streaming responses (client-side event handling and reconnects), and tool-calling (declaring and handling function signatures). The deliverables should include: (1) a single-page composable illustration set for docs (desktop and mobile breakpoints), (2) a sequence of 6 tilt-card frames that can be exported as GIF/MP4 for release notes, (3) a developer-ready component kit (SVGs + JSON tokens) for the docs team, and (4) annotated handoff notes for engineering (props, copy snippets, accessibility considerations). Focus on minimizing novelty in UX patterns so engineers can parse examples quickly; prioritize clarity for first-time integrators over decorative detail.
acceptance_criteria: Six tilt-card frames exported at 1200x600 (desktop) and 640x360 (mobile)
Illustrations use existing Redwood brand tokens (colors, spacing, iconography) — provided in design_notes
Each flow includes one runnable code snippet (curl + JS SDK) and an accompanying caption that matches SDK naming conventions
Figma file contains separate layers for live text and assets; exported assets are optimized for web (SVG for vector, PNG fallback for older docs)
Accessibility: all images have descriptive alt text; color contrast checked to AA for body copy and icons
Handoff checklist completed with component names, token keys, and a minimal CSS example for tilt-card interactions
design_notes: Visual motif: tactile 'tilt' cards with subtle parallax on hover and focus — prefer 3D transform Y/X at 6px
Typography: Inter 15/20 for body, Inter 16/22 semi-bold for headings in frames
Iconography: use compact dev icons (key, stopwatch/stream, puzzle-piece/function) from Redwood icon set
Motion: entrance and exit should be 180ms ease; streaming indicator should pulse at 700ms loop
Copy constraints: 1–2 sentences per card; code snippets max 3 lines for hero frames
Dev handoff: include props for card tilt (tiltAmount, transitionDur, prefersReducedMotion fallback)
